professional_summary: Analytics Engineer with 5+ years of experience building the transformation layers, data models, and pipelines that turn raw operational data into reliable, analytics-ready assets. At Austal USA, I sit at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence - I design the semantic layer that standardizes KPIs across six departments, build the PySpark pipelines that ingest 2M+ records daily from 20+ heterogeneous sources, and partner with BI consumers to make sure the data they're getting is both accurate and actually answers the question they're asking. I've reduced data retrieval from 10 minutes to under 2 seconds, enabled 95% faster root-cause analysis, and built reusable pipeline templates that cut new project onboarding by 60%. I'm looking for a role where data transformation is the craft, not an afterthought.

Architect and automate ETL/ELT pipelines that reduced data retrieval latency from 10 minutes to under 2 seconds - transforming what used to be a manual daily preparation task into a live, sub-second data feed that leadership depends on.

Build and enforce a data governance framework covering lineage, naming conventions, schema standards, and refresh scheduling - cutting reporting errors by 25% and achieving ISO 9001 compliance across data assets.

Write Python-based anomaly detection pipelines that continuously validate incoming production data, automatically flagging deviations and data quality issues before they propagate downstream into dashboards or reports.

Design reusable pipeline templates and transformation modules, cutting new project data onboarding time by 60% and enabling the team to launch new analytics workstreams without rebuilding from scratch each time.

Collaborate directly with BI consumers - operations leads, QA managers, procurement teams - to translate business questions into data model requirements, ensuring the transformation layer answers real questions, not just easy ones.
